customMethods.script:

	self.getDTByCategory()

	self.getDTByItem()

	self.view.custom.info = {"showBar": False, "text": "", "type": "INFO"}

customMethods.name: getDTSummary
customMethods.script:
dtName = 'summary'	
	self.view.custom.data[dtName] = system.dataset.toDataSet([],[])

	params = self.view.custom.filter
	if params['assetId'] is None: return
	
	durationSecs = (params['duration'] or 0) * 60
	
	self.view.custom.info = {"showBar": True, "text": "Getting %s state events..."%dtName, "type": "INFO"}	
	paramsDict = {'assetId': params['assetId'], 'startDate': params['startDate'], 'endDate': params['endDate'], 'showDowntimeOnly': True, 'showChanged': None, 'durationSecs': durationSecs}
	self.view.custom.data[dtName] = system.dataset.sort(system.kanoa.event.getAssetStateEventsSummary(paramsDict), 'durationSecs', False)
	
	return

customMethods.name: getDTInterval
customMethods.script:
dtName = 'interval'
	self.view.custom.data[dtName] = system.dataset.toDataSet([],[])

	params = self.view.custom.filter
	if params['assetId'] is None: return
		
	durationSecs = (params['duration'] or 0) * 60
	
	deviceUTCOffsetMins = int(self.session.props.device.timezone.utcOffset * 60)
	durationHrs = system.date.hoursBetween(params['startDate'], params['endDate'])
	if durationHrs <= 48: interval = 'Hour' 
	elif durationHrs <= 744: interval = 'Day'
	else: interval = 'Week'
	
	self.view.custom.data.intervalType = interval	
	self.view.custom.info = {"showBar": True, "text": "Getting %s state events..."%dtName, "type": "INFO"}
	paramsDict = {'assetId':params['assetId'], 'startDate': params['startDate'], 'endDate': params['endDate'], 'durationSecs': durationSecs, 'showChanged': None, 'showDowntimeOnly': True, 'interval': interval, 'deviceUTCOffsetMins': deviceUTCOffsetMins}
	self.view.custom.data[dtName] = system.kanoa.event.getAssetStateEventsByInterval(paramsDict)

	return
